DCGM Exporter metrics, visualized in Grafana
caption: The community NVIDIA DCGM Exporter dashboard — GPU temperature, power, and clock panels, the layout the platform team adapts for solara-train.

eyebrow: Busy isn't the same as doing useful math
code:
# "Is a kernel running at all"
avg(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL) by (Hostname)

# "Are the Tensor Cores specifically doing work"
avg(DCGM_FI_PROF_PIPE_TENSOR_ACTIVE) by (Hostname)

# high GPU_UTIL + low PIPE_TENSOR_ACTIVE =
# busy, but not doing much useful compute
caption: High GPU_UTIL with low PIPE_TENSOR_ACTIVE points at data loading, communication, or kernel inefficiency upstream.
